name: Shadows of Saintfour 2
source:
The town has been split into two: the new part and the old one, infected by a deadly flower. A high school journalist ventures into the restricted zone to uncover what has long been hidden in the shadows of Saintfour. 
[From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Shadows_of_Saintfour_2]romance-club.fandom[/url]]
translation:
整座小镇已被一分为二：一边是新城区，另一边则是被致命毒花感染的旧城区。一名高中生记者只身闯入封锁禁区，誓要揭开长久以来深藏于圣弗尔暗影之中的真相。
[摘自[url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Shadows_of_Saintfour_2]romance-club.fandom[/url]]
